title: Manager, Customer Success Scaled Accounts
description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Manager, Customer Success, Scaled Accounts in India with atleast 10 years of exp to lead a high\-performing team supporting a scaled portfolio of smaller customers through a lighter\-touch, high\-volume Customer Success motion. This role is designed to bridge the gap between digital\-only coverage and strategic named coverage, with a focus on protecting ARR, improving customer outcomes, and delivering strong in\-timezone support across APAC and Middle East customers.
   

  

 Unlike a traditional Customer Success leadership role focused on a smaller number of large, strategic accounts, this manager will lead a more programmatic, high\-scale model. The focus is on retention, renewal readiness, operational excellence, portfolio health, team productivity, and coordinated customer support rather than deep executive sponsorship of a limited number of complex enterprise relationships.
   

  

 This is a strong fit for a leader who combines Customer Success judgment with operating discipline, coaching capability, technical fluency, and the ability to build a repeatable scaled motion that delivers strong customer outcomes at efficient cost.
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 This role is being created to address a clear coverage gap in International Customer Success. OneTrust has identified a meaningful population of customers below the strategic named\-CS threshold who still need guided support, especially in the 50–100K ARR band, where a scaled human\-touch motion can improve retention and customer outcomes without the cost of full strategic coverage.
   

  

 The role also supports the key outcomes identified in the India team strategy: higher retention, better APAC and Growth coverage, greater resilience during attrition or handoffs, and sharper focus for strategic CSMs on their highest\-complexity accounts.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* Build and lead a scaled Customer Success team in India that delivers consistent, high\-quality coverage for smaller accounts through a lighter\-touch, repeatable engagement model.
* Improve retention and renewal readiness across the assigned book of business by ensuring strong execution, early risk identification, and disciplined customer follow\-through.
* Create a lower\-cost, high\-impact coverage layer that strengthens support for APAC and Middle East customers while allowing strategic CSMs to stay focused on larger, more complex accounts.
* Establish the operating rhythms, team standards, portfolio segmentation, and success measures needed to run scaled Customer Success effectively.
* Act as a continuity and performance leader who can stabilize coverage during transitions, support cross\-functional execution, and scale what works.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership and Coaching**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of scaled CSMs supporting a larger\-volume portfolio of smaller customers.
* Set clear performance expectations around retention, renewal readiness, customer engagement quality, operational hygiene, and portfolio management.
* Provide regular coaching on customer communication, prioritization, risk management, product guidance, and account execution.
* Support hiring, onboarding, ramping, and career development for the India\-based scaled CS team.


**Scaled Motion Design and Execution**
* Build and run a structured, repeatable Customer Success motion for smaller accounts, including engagement cadences, success planning lite, adoption check\-ins, renewal\-readiness touchpoints, and proactive risk reviews.
* Define how the team segments accounts, prioritizes effort, and balances breadth of coverage with quality of execution.
* Ensure the team delivers value in a scalable way rather than replicating a strategic named\-account model.
* Continuously refine playbooks, workflows, and intervention triggers to improve efficiency and outcomes.


**Retention and Renewal Performance**
* Own renewal performance and retained ARR outcomes across the scaled team’s portfolio in partnership with Sales, Renewals, ECS, and Support.
* Ensure the team identifies churn risk early, drives mitigation plans, and improves readiness ahead of renewal events.
* Track portfolio health trends and turn signals into clear actions, escalation paths, and performance improvements.
* Use data to focus the team on the accounts and motions that create the greatest retention impact.


**Customer Experience And Regional Coverage**
* Improve in\-timezone responsiveness and customer experience for APAC, Middle East, and other assigned regions.
* Ensure smaller customers receive the right level of guidance, follow\-up, and product support without unnecessary complexity.
* Build a team culture that combines customer empathy with efficiency, clarity, and accountability.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Partner closely with Support, Product, Professional Services, CSAs, Sales, Renewals, and regional CS leaders to improve customer outcomes and reduce execution friction.
* Create strong handoff and escalation processes between scaled coverage and strategic coverage.
* Surface recurring product, process, and customer experience themes that should inform broader Customer Success strategy.
* Act as a key stakeholder in designing how scaled Customer Success complements digital and named models.


**Operational Management and Capacity Planning**
* Manage team capacity, portfolio allocation, coverage continuity, and productivity across a high\-volume book of business.
* Maintain strong CRM and Gainsight hygiene, reporting discipline, and inspection rhythms.
* Help create resilience in the operating model during attrition, parental leaves, backfills, or organizational transitions.
* Report on business performance with clear metrics and recommendations for leadership.


**Success Measures**
 Success in this role will be measured through a combination of business impact, team performance, and operational execution, including:
   

  

* Renewal rate and retained ARR across the scaled portfolio.
* Improvement in renewal\-readiness execution and risk mitigation quality.
* Team productivity across a higher\-volume book of business.
* Response time, backlog management, and follow\-through for APAC and Middle East customers.
* Strength of CRM and Gainsight hygiene, signal capture, and portfolio inspection.
* Quality of hiring, onboarding, coaching, and team development.
* Ability to create a scalable, repeatable Customer Success motion that improves outcomes without the cost of a full strategic coverage model.


**Experience And Skills Required**
* Proven experience leading Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, Professional Services, Solutions Consulting, or another customer\-facing SaaS team.
* Prior people\-management experience, including coaching, performance management, and team development.
* Strong understanding of scaled or commercial Customer Success models, including how to run high\-volume portfolios effectively.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity, align stakeholders, and lead through clarity.
* Good technical fluency and the ability to guide teams supporting product adoption, customer questions, and use\-case problem solving.
* Strong operational discipline, analytical thinking, prioritization, and execution rigor.
* Customer\-first mindset, sound judgment, and comfort working cross\-functionally in a fast\-moving environment.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on operating leadership.


**Preferred Background**
* Experience with OneTrust products or with comparable privacy, GRC, data governance, consent, or compliance platforms.
* Experience leading SMB, mid\-market, commercial, or scaled Customer Success teams rather than only strategic enterprise coverage.
* Experience supporting customers across APAC, Middle East, or other international markets.
* Experience building or improving playbooks, operating cadences, and portfolio\-management frameworks for scaled teams.
* Comfort operating in a lighter\-touch CS motion that is structured, repeatable, and commercially disciplined.


**What Makes This Role Different**
 This is not a traditional strategic Customer Success leadership role. It is a scaled\-team management role for a leader who can build a broader\-coverage model, run a higher\-volume operating motion, and deliver strong retention and customer outcomes through disciplined, programmatic execution.
   

  

 The role is designed to extend quality human coverage to customers who matter commercially but do not require the depth of a strategic $100K\+ named\-CSM model. Success will come from building a repeatable team motion that protects ARR, improves responsiveness, and strengthens the overall International Customer Success model.
   

  

 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data
   

  

 You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
   

  

**Our Commitment to You**
 When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
   

  

 OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Manager, Customer Care
description:
**The Company**
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
   

  

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 Join PayPal’s Global Partner Management team within Service Experience, overseeing outsourced partners in India that support customer service for PayPal, Venmo and Xoom across global markets. You will drive partner governance, operational performance, service quality and financial accountability across the outsourced network. The role connects partner sites with teams including Workforce Management, Training, Compliance and Risk, using operational and customer insights to strengthen service delivery, address performance gaps and ensure partners consistently meet PayPal standards.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**
* Implement a multi\-phased strategy to enhance the overall customer experience.
* Identify customer pain points and develop data\-driven improvement strategies.
* Lead cross\-functional teams to prioritize and execute customer\-focused initiatives.

* Leverage data and analytics to assess costs, measure performance, and report on business impact.
* Manage complex programs by documenting service capabilities and driving innovation.
* Create and present business cases, projects, and analyses in a clear and compelling manner.


**Minimum Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.


**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of experience in vendor or partner management, contact\-center operations, or operational excellence, with demonstrated success driving measurable performance improvements in an outsourced operating model.
* Proven experience managing BPO or outsourced customer\-service providers and establishing effective partner\-governance practices.
* Strong knowledge of contact\-center operations and KPIs such as AHT, FCR, CSAT and NPS.
* Experience with workforce planning, operational cost management and partner capacity or location planning.
* Strong analytical capabilities, including translating complex operational data into clear recommendations and actions.
* Experience with structured root\-cause analysis and continuous\-improvement methodologies.
* Process and project management experience; familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma or equivalent operational frameworks is preferred.
* FinTech or financial\-services experience is preferred.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, including communicating operational insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate effectively across global, cross\-functional teams and outsourced partner environments.
* Interest in emerging technologies, including AI, and their application to customer\-service operations and operational efficiency.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Manage the operational performance and governance of outsourced customer\-service partners in India supporting multiple global markets.
* Develop partner scorecards and lead Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews to evaluate performance, establish priorities and agree improvement roadmaps.

 PayPal

 For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

title: Forward Deployed Client Partner
description:
**Forward Deployed Client Partner** 




**Fibr AI \| Bengaluru (On\-site) \| Full\-time Experience: 1\-3 years** 




  





 You've spent your first couple of years in Customer Success learning how to keep a client happy. You've run calls, chased tickets, kept the dashboard green. But you've also noticed that most of the real decisions get made above you, and your job is mostly to execute a system someone else built.
 



 This is the role where you stop executing someone else's system and start learning how to build one.
 



  





**WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT** 




  





 Most junior CSM roles at bigger SaaS companies put you in a narrow lane: one part of the client journey, a script to follow, a senior person who owns the actual relationship. Here, you own the relationship from week one. You run the onboarding, you sit on the client calls, you make the judgment calls on what needs to be escalated and what you can solve yourself. You will have people to learn from, but the account is yours to run.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 



1. **Own the onboarding journey** 
 Run kickoff calls, gather requirements, and get new clients live fast. You will lead the technical onboarding conversations directly with client teams, not sit in on someone else's call.
2. **Be the client's first point of contact** 
 Handle the day\-to\-day relationship: the weekly check\-ins, the status updates, the moments where a client needs to hear from a real person, not a ticket number. You decide what gets communicated and when.
3. **Learn to diagnose, not just relay** 
 Get comfortable digging into a script issue, a tracking problem, or a campaign question yourself before looping in tech. You will build real technical fluency here, not just people skills.
4. **Build judgment fast** 
 You will decide what is urgent, what can wait, and what needs to be flagged up. Nobody hands you a rulebook for this. You build the instinct by doing it.
5. **Shape how this function grows** 
 We are building our Customer Success playbook now, and your experience in your first few months will directly shape how the next person after you gets onboarded and trained.



**WHO THIS IS FOR** 



1. 1 to 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Onboarding, Account Management, or a similarly client\-facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS, martech, or a fast\-moving tech environment.
2. You are not afraid of the technical side. Tracking scripts, integrations, campaign data, you want to understand how things actually work, not just report on them.
3. You communicate clearly and proactively. If something is going to be late, the client hears it from you before they have to ask.
4. You want more ownership than your current role gives you, and you are ready to earn it fast.



  





**HOW WE WORK** 




 You will work closely with a small, experienced team and have real access to how decisions get made here. There is no ladder of approvals between you and getting something done for a client.
 



  





**WHY FIBR AI** 




 Fibr AI is building the agentic web layer, infrastructure that turns static websites into intelligent, personalized experiences. We work with major enterprise clients across fintech, insurance, healthcare, and consumer brands. Backed by Accel, early team, meaningful growth ahead, and a real chance to grow fast alongside the company.

 Job Resposibilities
   

  

**First\-Line Business Support** 
 : Provide responsive first\-line support for data issues, deals and bookings. Assess requests, clarify business impact, coordinate resolution and maintain clear communication through closure.
   

  

**Q2O \& FPVR Process Support** 
 : Support Quote\-to\-Order and FPVR processes by resolving operational questions, identifying breakdowns, coordinating corrective action and improving support consistency.
   

  

**Global Accounts Support** 
 : Provide dependable support for global and strategic accounts, recognizing cross\-region dependencies, urgency and revenue impact while coordinating stakeholders toward timely resolution.
   

  

**Renewal Specialist Enablement** 
 : Enable Renewal Specialists with accurate data, actionable reporting, process guidance and structured issue support that improves productivity and customer outcomes.
   

  

**Data, Analytics \& Reporting** 
 : Use data analysis and reporting to identify trends, recurring issues, problem areas and improvement opportunities. Quantify business value, expected benefits and ROI to support prioritization and informed decisions.
   

  

**Issue Triage \& Resolution** 
 : Establish effective intake, prioritization, ownership and escalation practices. Track issues to closure, identify root causes and reduce repeat incidents.
   

  

**Process Efficiency :** 
 Identify opportunities to simplify support processes, remove handoffs and redundancies, reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time, quality and stakeholder experience.
   

  

**Program Governance \& Leadership**

title: Franchise Area Manager
description:
**Job Description – Franchise Area Manager** 




**Position** 




**Franchise Area Manager** 




**Department** 





 Franchise Operations
 




**Reporting To** 





 Senior Operations Manager / Head – Franchise Operations
 




**Role Overview** 





 The Franchise Area Manager will be responsible for managing and driving the overall performance of franchise outlets within the assigned area. The role involves franchise partner management, operational excellence, sales growth, new store openings, compliance, issue resolution, and coordination with internal teams such as Finance, SCM, Marketing, Training, and Business Development.
 





 The candidate will act as the primary point of contact between the brand and franchise partners and will ensure that all outlets operate in line with brand standards and business objectives.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Franchise Partner Management** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with franchise partners.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational and business\-related concerns.
* Understand partner concerns and provide timely solutions.
* Conduct regular partner reviews and performance discussions.
* Ensure effective communication of brand policies, initiatives, campaigns, and operational updates.
* Drive partner engagement and improve overall partner satisfaction.



**2\. Store Operations \& Performance** 



* Monitor day\-to\-day operations of assigned franchise outlets.
* Track outlet sales, profitability, customer experience, operational compliance, and service standards.
* Identify performance gaps and prepare corrective action plans.
* Conduct regular store visits and audits.
* Ensure adherence to SOPs, food quality, hygiene, service, and brand standards.
* Follow up on operational issues until closure.



**3\. Sales \& Business Growth** 



* Drive sales growth across the assigned franchise network.
* Analyse outlet\-wise sales trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Track key business metrics such as sales, AOV, order volumes, discounts, online visibility, and customer ratings.
* Work with partners to improve outlet profitability.
* Identify underperforming outlets and implement action plans.
* Monitor aggregator performance across platforms such as Swiggy and Zomato.



**4\. New Store Opening / NSO** 



* Coordinate end\-to\-end new store opening activities for assigned outlets.
* Work closely with BD, Projects, SCM, Marketing, Training, Finance, and franchise partners.
* Ensure outlet readiness before launch.
* Track equipment, inventory, branding, licenses, training, aggregator onboarding, and other launch requirements.
* Ensure smooth transition from pre\-opening to post\-opening operations.
* Monitor the performance of newly opened outlets during the initial period.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Coordinate with
 
**Finance** 

 for royalty, outstanding payments, credit notes, settlements, and other partner\-related financial matters.
* Coordinate with
 
**SCM** 

 for stock availability, supply issues, transportation, and procurement concerns.
* Coordinate with
 
**Marketing** 

 for campaigns, creatives, promotions, local marketing, and NSO activities.
* Coordinate with
 
**Training** 

 to ensure franchise staff receive required product and operational training.
* Coordinate with
 
**Tech/IT** 

 for Rista, POS, aggregator, and other system\-related issues.
* Work with the
 
**Legal team** 

 for agreements, amendments, notices, and franchise\-related documentation.



**6\. Compliance \& Brand Standards** 



* Ensure franchise partners comply with all brand, statutory, and operational requirements.
* Monitor FSSAI, licenses, agreements, certificates, and other mandatory documentation.
* Conduct periodic audits and ensure closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, quality, and brand standards.



**7\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation Management** 



* Take ownership of franchise partner escalations.
* Analyse root causes and provide practical solutions.
* Ensure issues are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Escalate critical matters to senior management with clear facts, impact, and recommended action.
* Maintain an issue tracker and ensure there are no repeated unresolved concerns.



**8\. Reporting \& MIS** 



* Maintain regular outlet and franchise partner trackers.
* Prepare weekly/monthly performance reports.
* Track sales, collections, NSO, outlet performance, audits, complaints, and action points.
* Share business insights and improvement plans with management.
* Maintain accurate records of partner discussions and commitments.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Outlet Sales Growth
* Same Store Sales Growth
* Franchisee Profitability
* Franchise Partner Satisfaction
* New Store Opening Timelines
* New Store Ramp\-up Performance
* Operational Audit Scores
* Issue Resolution TAT
* Royalty / Outstanding Collection
* Aggregator Performance
* Customer Ratings \& Complaints
* SOP \& Compliance Adherence
* Partner Retention



**Required Skills** 



* Strong franchise and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of retail/F\&B operations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple franchise partners and outlets simultaneously.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through.
* Good knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and MIS reporting.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.



**Experience \& Qualification** 



* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM preferred.
* **3–6 years of experience** 

 in franchise operations, retail, QSR, F\&B, hospitality, or similar industries.
* Prior experience in managing franchise partners and multiple outlets will be preferred.
* Experience in new store openings and outlet operations will be an added advantage.



**Key Competencies** 




**Partner Management \| Business Acumen \| Operations Excellence \| Sales Orientation \| Problem Solving \| Ownership \| Decision Making \| Communication \| Negotiation \| Team Coordination \| Analytical Thinking**

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

description:
**About BiteSpeed**
 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.**
 We’re currently working with
 **3000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
   

  

 💡
 **Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!**
**Check out more about us here** 
 \- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).
   

  

**We’ve had some solid investors back us** 
 (making it easier for you to stalk us since you’d do this anyway) \-
   

  

 Ecommerce AI startup BiteSpeed raised USD 3\.5 million
   

  

 E\-commerce AI start\-up BiteSpeed raises $3\.5 million funding led by Peak XV’s Surge
   

  

 BiteSpeed Raises $1\.9 Million Seed Funding From Sequoia India's Surge
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an
 **Enterprise** 
**Account Manager** 
 to own the
 **entire customer lifecycle** 
 at BiteSpeed — from onboarding and implementation to retention, renewals, cross\-sell, upsell, and account expansion.
   

  

 This isn't a traditional customer success role focused only on support and relationship management. We're looking for someone who can
 **build strong customer relationships while also identifying growth opportunities and driving revenue from existing accounts.**
 You'll work closely with customers to help them achieve their goals, maximize the value they derive from BiteSpeed, and uncover opportunities to expand their partnership with us.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the end\-to\-end customer journey — onboarding, implementation, adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships and become a trusted advisor for your customers.
* Lead customer onboarding and ensure a smooth implementation experience with faster time\-to\-value.
* Drive product adoption and customer engagement by helping customers unlock the full potential of BiteSpeed.
* Own renewals and retention, ensuring customers continue to achieve measurable business outcomes.
* Proactively identify and drive cross\-sell, upsell, and expansion opportunities across your portfolio.
* Work closely with customers to understand their business goals, growth plans, and evolving requirements to uncover additional revenue opportunities.
* Monitor account health, product usage, and engagement metrics to identify both risk signals and growth opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal teams across product, sales, support, and growth to deliver a seamless customer experience.


**What Makes You a Good Fit**
* You have 2\-5 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar customer\-facing role.
* You have hands\-on experience managing the complete customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.
* You have a strong commercial mindset and are comfortable driving cross\-sell, upsell, and revenue growth within existing accounts.
* You enjoy consultative conversations and can confidently discuss ROI, business outcomes, and growth opportunities with customers.
* You can balance customer advocacy with business goals, creating win\-win outcomes for both.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced environment and can manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously.
* You genuinely enjoy helping customers succeed and take ownership of building long\-term partnerships.


 Salary and Location
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team.
   

  

**Our Way Of Life**
 Over time we’ve realised that while we’re super excited about shaping the future of commerce, a big part of why people join us and stick with us is because they resonate with our way of life. You could call it work culture \- but it ends up becoming more than just that.
   

  

 It’s taken us time to discover and articulate what our culture feels like, this evolving document is an attempt to candidly share what it’s like working at BiteSpeed.
   

  

**Our Purpose**
 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create. Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-
   

  

* Personal Transformation


 We like to think of BiteSpeed as being a gym for our careers. It’s where we come to do great work we can be proud of and push ourselves in the pursuit of excellence. Is it comfortable? No. Is it painful? Sometimes. Is it fulfilling? Yes.
   

  

 We were never the company that was supposed to win \- We started out of a dorm room, solo founder, early engineers who hadn’t written code in their lives setting out to build a global SaaS company.
   

  

 Our roots are in doing things we are unqualified for and we bet on people who want that journey for themselves. There are stories of people across the company from a 20 year old who’s never done sales closing enterprise deals to a college intern owning an enterprise product lifecycle \- these are the stories we are proud of. If someone can look back after 2 years of working at BiteSpeed and say they don’t identify with who they were, we’d call it a success and we want to help them get there.
   

  

* Wealth Creation


 Somehow most companies are shy about wanting to make money. It’s looked at as this thing which everyone does but no one really talks about.
   

  

 We’re not ashamed of doing it for the money. Wealth unlocks choice. If life is an amusement park, we think there is value to getting an unlimited rides pass. It's purposeful for us to try to create wealth that allows people to achieve their life's dreams \- whether that's owning a house or booking a dream vacation for their parents. We do this by ensuring everyone in the team gets equity and there are generous cash \& equity bumps on a frequent basis to reward performance and alignment in values.
   

  

* Winning Together


 We’re not here for a participation certificate. We’re playing to win. The keyword here is ‘together’. Winning ‘together’ is about recognising it’s a team sport. We don't care about man of the match awards, either we win the trophy or we don’t. There is a certain camaraderie that comes with winning together that’s hard to explain, but it’s deeply fulfilling and energising. The question we ask ourselves is \- can we play the game like it’s never been played before?
   

  

 Our Values
   

  

 Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.
   

  

 We have 5 core values:\-
   

  

* Go Above And Beyond


 We value people who care about doing a good job. Going above and beyond is about doing more than the bare minimum that gets the job done and raising the bar each time we have the opportunity to do so
   

  

* Making Things Happen


 Each company has an operating rhythm and this is that for us. Making things happen is the opposite of being passive. It’s about high agency, about always believing there is a way to get what we want and either finding the way or making the way
   

  

* Say It Like It Is


 We are candid and direct when it comes to sharing feedback, transparent with our numbers and intellectually honest about the realities of any business situation
   

  

* Progress Over Perfection


 We’re not building rockets. We care about moving fast and iterating towards perfection. We like to take a minimum viable approach to prioritisation and problem solving and actively look for 80/20 solutions
   

  

* Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously


 Great things are built when people can contribute to pursuits beyond themselves. Being low ego, not needing praise to do a good job, taking feedback with humility, being self\-critical all add up to this
   

  

 Perks \& Benefits
   

  

 Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning \& keep things fun:\-
   

  

* Health Insurance \- Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.
* Quarterly Off\-sites \- Quarterly off\-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off\-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).
* Cult Fitness Membership \- All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.
* Personal Development \- We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* Salary In Advance \- Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.


 How to apply?
   

  

 If this sounds interesting, apply on our
 **latest Job Post on Linkedin** 
 .
   

  

 Wanna stand out?
 **Drop a personal note** 
 with why you'd want to work with us and what makes you a good fit on
 **talent@bitespeed.co** 
 . Tell us about the happiest you’ve made a customer and the most difficult customer you’ve handled.
   

  

 Know someone who might be a great fit?
 **Refer them to us** 
 , if they end up joining we'll send you an
 **Apple Airpods Pro** 
 as a gesture of thanks!
   

  

 For any queries feel free to write to talent@bitespeed.co.

description:
**About Bureau** 




 Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision\-making engine, powered by a 1 billion\+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
 



  





 Bureau has raised $50M\+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
 



  





**Why Bureau?** 




  





 Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
 



  





 We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
 



  





**About the Role \- Manager \- Technical Support** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Manager – Technical Support** 
 to lead the Bureau's global Technical Support organization. In this role, you will drive world\-class support operations for enterprise customers by leading high\-performing teams, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.
 



  





 You will manage a team of Technical Support and Integration Engineers responsible for resolving complex issues across APIs, SDKs, integrations, and platform services. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Sales, you will drive SLA adherence, manage customer escalations, improve support processes, and eliminate recurring customer issues through data\-driven improvements.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





**Technical Support Operations** 




  





 Lead and scale a global Technical Support team supporting enterprise customers(Banking, FinTech, Ecommerce etc).
 


* Ensure SLA compliance, rapid response, timely resolution, and high customer satisfaction.
* Monitor ticket queues, manage workload distribution, and optimize workforce planning across shifts.
* Reduce ticket backlog, improve queue health, and drive operational efficiency.
* Lead critical customer incidents and executive escalations with clear and proactive communication.
* Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve customer issues and improve product reliability.
* Identify recurring issues and drive root cause elimination.



  





**People Leadership** 




  




* Lead, coach, and develop Technical Support and Integration Engineers.
* Set measurable goals, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.
* Recruit, onboard, and retain top talent.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer focus.



  





**Operational Excellence** 




  




* Own key support metrics including SLA Compliance, First Response Time, Resolution Time, Queue Health, Backlog, CSAT, Escalations, and Engineer Productivity.
* Prepare operational dashboards and present performance insights to leadership.
* Drive automation, process improvements, and operational best practices.
* Develop and maintain support playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.



  





**Technical Leadership** 




  




* Build deep expertise across Bureau's products, APIs, SDKs, and integrations.
* Guide engineers in troubleshooting complex application, integration, API, SDk, database, and platform issues.
* Ensure complete diagnostics and quality root cause analysis before Engineering engagement.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to improve platform/ product stability and customer experience.



  





**What you'll bring** 




  





**Customer Support Leadership** 




  




* Proven experience leading enterprise Technical Support teams.
* Strong expertise in customer lifecycle management, incident handling, and executive escalations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and customer relationship skills.



  





**Support Operations** 




  




* Experience managing L2/L3 support organizations with expertise in:
* Ticket Queue Management
* Workforce Planning \& Scheduling
* SLA \& Incident Management
* Escalation Management
* Backlog Reduction
* Operational Reporting



 Experience supporting global customers across multiple time zones is preferred.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




  




* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS platforms with experience in:
* SQL
* REST APIs
* Web \& Mobile SDKs
* Third\-party Integrations
* Application Logs \& Databases
* Monitoring and Log tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Superset, and AWS
* Networking, Scripting, and Programming
* Exposure to AI/ML\-powered support tools and automation



  





**Leadership** 




  




* Proven experience managing high\-performing technical teams.
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in Technical Support or Product Support, including leadership experience.
* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS products and globally distributed teams.
* Experience in FinTech, Banking, Identity Verification, or Digital Fraud Prevention is a plus.



  





**Our Culture** 




  




* We hire self\-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most



  





**Compensation** 




  




* Competitive salary \+ potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

 CTC, basis qualifications, experience and current CTC.

title: Senior Analyst, Business Operations
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Associate, Customer Success Partner to support day\-to\-day merchant operations and deliver outstanding customer experience. The ideal candidate will assist in resolving merchant queries, ensuring smooth transaction flows, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams for timely issue resolution. A basic understanding of payment methods and reconciliation processes will be an added advantage. This role is a great opportunity for someone who is eager to learn and grow in the fintech/customer success space.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Ownership of Merchant Issues:
+ Handle complex or high\-value merchant concerns, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution with minimal follow\-ups.

* Escalation Management:
+ Take ownership of L2/L3 escalations, coordinate with cross\-functional teams (Product, Risk, Tech, FinOps), and ensure root cause identification and resolution.

* Workflow Optimization \& SOP Design:
+ Identify gaps in current processes and contribute to the creation or improvement of SOPs to enhance resolution efficiency and merchant experience.

* Merchant Communication \& Stakeholder Alignment:
+ Maintain clear and professional communication with merchants and internal stakeholders to keep all parties informed on resolution progress.

* Operational Reporting \& Metrics Tracking:
+ Track SLAs, TATs, and resolution quality metrics; generate reports for leadership to monitor performance and identify bottlenecks.

* Mentorship \& Peer Support:
+ Guide and mentor junior associates, conduct case reviews, and ensure adherence to quality and tone standards.

* Special Projects \& Initiatives:
+ Lead or contribute to strategic projects such as refund pattern analysis, feature enablement audits, or new payment flow adoption.

* Product Feedback Loop:
+ Identify and relay recurring merchant feedback or product issues to the product/tech teams for prioritization.

* Audit Readiness \& Compliance:
+ Ensure all customer interactions, tickets, and resolutions are properly documented to support internal or regulatory audits.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, or a related field.
* Experience : Minimum 2–3 years of experience in customer service, operations, or a similar domain.
* Knowledge of Payment Ecosystem : Familiarity with UPI, Net Banking, Card Payments, eNACH, settlement processes, and refund mechanisms.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

**Company Description** 
 NoBroker.com is India’s first proptech unicorn and a brokerage\-free property search platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers. Founded in 2014 by alumni of IIT Bombay, IIT Kanpur, and IIM Ahmedabad, the company now serves over 3 million customers every month across major Indian cities. Backed by global investors including Google, General Atlantic, and Tiger Global, NoBroker.com uses advanced technology to remove information asymmetry from the real estate market and enable transparent, direct interactions. The company offers a wide range of services such as verified listings, rental agreements, home services, loans, and society management software, with dedicated support for both domestic and NRI customers. Team members work in a high\-growth, merit\-driven environment with strong learning opportunities and competitive compensation.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Property Relationship Manager – Sarjapur will be responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with property owners and tenants in the Sarjapur area of Bengaluru. This full\-time, on\-site role involves assisting customers through the end\-to\-end property search and transaction process, including understanding requirements, recommending suitable properties, coordinating site visits, and facilitating negotiations. The role includes regular interaction with clients via phone and in person, managing inquiries from the NoBroker.com platform, and ensuring a smooth experience from first contact to closure. The Property Relationship Manager will help maintain accurate property information, provide market insights, and collaborate with internal teams to resolve issues and improve service quality. The position is based in Bengaluru and requires frequent local travel within the Sarjapur vicinity.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong customer relationship management and client servicing skills, with the ability to understand and match property requirements effectively.
* Sales and negotiation capabilities, including experience in handling leads, converting prospects, and meeting or exceeding targets.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English and local languages, with a professional and empathetic customer approach.
* Good organizational and time management skills, including the ability to handle multiple leads, maintain accurate records, and follow structured processes.
* Comfort with technology and mobile/web applications, with the ability to use CRM tools and the NoBroker.com platform efficiently.
* Prior experience in real estate, field sales, or consumer\-facing roles is highly desirable.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in any discipline; additional certifications in sales, real estate, or customer service are an advantage.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Bengaluru and travel within the Sarjapur area as required.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - (DATA 360 Mandatory)
description:
**Description**
**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. We're looking for Trailblazers passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Technical Consultant supports a work stream in sophisticated enterprise customer engagements, partnering with key stakeholders to achieve the vision while completing key deliverables. They serve as hands\-on advisors — using strong solution, technical, and product knowledge, plus industry and consulting experience — to deliver customer ROI.
   

  

 Senior Technical Consultants demonstrate thought leadership in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements, leading to successful delivery of enterprise desktop, cloud, and/or mobile solutions, including enterprise integrations via middleware tools and platforms. They lead the evaluation of options, present and educate customers/partners, and proactively manage risk areas through to resolution.
   

  

**Your Impact — Responsibilities**
* Become a highly certified and recognized Salesforce expert
* Help clients consistently meet/exceed goals and metrics
* Contribute to customer success through front\- and back\-end solution development and release management
* Deliver high client satisfaction (CSAT)
* Guide application/integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, functional and technical solution architecture \& design, environment management, testing, and Salesforce Platform education
* Up\-skill on AI Fluency and AI\-Native delivery methodology, using AI tools and developer assistants (e.g., Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, Claude) and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate delivery
* Build relationships with internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals beyond a single customer engagement
* Drive creation of application and technical design documents that leverage Salesforce best practices and integrate Salesforce into customer infrastructure
* Troubleshoot key implementation issues and drive them to resolution; lead evaluation of business/technical requirements at a senior level
* Proactively identify and manage risk areas through to complete resolution
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with customers and third\-party partners
* Contribute to Services Practice growth by leading internal strategic initiatives, mentoring junior teammates, and enriching technical/non\-technical knowledge for customers and colleagues


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 2\+ years as a Lead Developer doing solution design in a mid\-to\-large organization, with demonstrated leadership driving organizational transformation in a matrixed org
* Experience with enterprise architecture areas: integration technologies, single sign\-on, master data management
* Experience with Waterfall and/or Agile methodologies
* Self\-starter with proven results leading customer/partner success across front\- and back\-end architecture, development, release management, and change management
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Skilled at guiding customers and colleagues in adopting emerging technologies that drive business value
* Polished speaker able to evangelize best practices at various organizational levels
* Genuine interest in studying new technologies and pushing the limits of existing ones
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, tailored to the audience
* Strong presentation skills — able to present and defend a point of view to varied audiences
* Willingness to travel to client sites (avg. 25%, may vary by engagement)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or related field


**Certifications**
 Helpful to have Salesforce.com product certifications before joining. Expected to earn these within the first 3 months:
   

  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Agentforce Service Consultant
* Salesforce Certified Agentforce Sales Consultant
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing \& Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect


**Preferred Qualifications — Leadership Qualities**
* Passion: Passionate about customer success
* Beginner's Mind: Always learning, open\-minded, a great listener, hands\-on
* Thought Leader: Strong point of view and executive presence — confident, not arrogant, a great storyteller
* Urgency: Moves fast and drives business value and results
* Ohana: Embodies Aloha culture — a team player with a generous heart
* Trust: Trusts the company's core values
* Adaptable: Excels amid high uncertainty and change

title: Transition Manager
description:
As a Transition Manager of the Global Business Services team, you will part of a dynamic team working across the enterprise to manage business process transitions from existing locations to offshore/nearshore or provider locations. Your primary focus will be transitions but other projects might be included as directed. Fresenius Medical Care is a fast\-paced environment, and we are looking for someone who can hit the ground running to manage multiple responsibilities and projects while producing high\-quality work.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Manage the transition scope and coordinate all stakeholders
* Build and manage transition plans
* Act independently to deliver to schedule, budget, and scope
* Run projects, monitor progress, track risks while escalating and driving to resolution as needed
* Report on status
* Support resource and financial reporting
* Run projects, monitor progress
* Execute project controls
* Support the business case creation, presentation, and gather approvals
* Create efficient and effective project plans, taking into consideration the respective organizational and operational structure needs and adjust approach accordingly
* Deliver on the transition/project plan Report project/transitions progress, and risks. Develop corrective action where necessary.
* Own communication and relationship with countries in respective region
* Execute on transitions/projects in line with recognized best practice methodology (planning, managing risk, governance, quality assurance, issue resolution, reporting) within the approved schedule
* Collect business/country requirements and understand the business needs
* Act as a liaison for all activities and stakeholders for assigned transition/project
* Manage day\-to\-day communication for assigned transition/project
* Manage the change and assess the risks and be able to implement proper mitigation plan where required.
* Coordinate and facilitate the process of documenting project/transition related policies and procedures, if required.
* Identify and document additional process improvements opportunities for possible implementation after the Transition and/or Projects closure.
* Coordinate the training/workshops of local personnel in the respected countries/regions or/and Shared Service Center employees
* Ensure seamless transfer of business processes from local sites to the Shared Services incl. service level agreements (in cooperation with GBS Service Management)
* Manage all stages of the migration process are successfully complete


**Qualifications:**
* Academic degree or equivalent experience in relevant subject matter
* Project Management certification is preferred
* Experience in transitioning complex projects
* Extended knowledge of service transition methodology, tools and templates. Has strong implementation experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in transition project management
* Good understanding of change management
* Background in business processes in BPO or Shared Service Center environment
* Knowledge of process improvement methodology a plus
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills paired with persuasiveness and self\-confidence with strong intercultural skills and understanding.
* Team Player with a strong drive to create positive work environment, able to motivate and empower employees. Ability to work effectively across team.
* Passion for continuous learning, ability to solid comprehension and fast familiarization with new and complex tasks
* Solution\-oriented, proactive and out of the box thinking personality
* Excellent skills to set priorities and self\-manage high volume workload
* Ability to take the lead and proactively work on solving the issues or potential risks
* Very good planning and organizational skills
* Ability to work independently in ambiguous, dynamic environment.
* Very structured way of working with focus on efficient and effective processes even under pressure


**Key Skills**
* Communication \- Able to clearly present information through the spoken or written word; read and interpret complex information; talk with customers or clients; listen well.
* Customer Focus \- Able to demonstrate a high level of service delivery; do what is necessary to ensure customer satisfaction; deal with service failures and prioritize customer needs.
* Flexibility \- Able to remain open\-minded and change opinions on the basis of new information; perform a wide variety of tasks and change focus quickly as demands change; manage transitions effectively from task to task; adapt to varying customer needs.
* Planning, Prioritizing, \& Goal Setting \- Able to prepare for emerging customer needs; manage multiple projects; determine project urgency in a meaningful and practical way; use goals to guide actions and create detailed action plans; organize and schedule people and tasks.
* Policies, Process, \& Procedures \- Able to act in accordance with established guidelines; follow standard procedures in crisis situations; communicate and enforce organizational policies and procedures; recognize and constructively conform to unwritten rules or practices.

title: Category Lead, Sports
description:
**Who we are** 




 Openhouse is building a new\-age learning ecosystem for children, bringing high\-quality
 



 learning experiences across academics, sports and extracurriculars closer to where children live.
 



 Backed by leading investors including Accel, Matrix Partners and GSV, Openhouse has grown to
 



 12 learning centres across Bangalore, reaching 10,000\+ children through our centres and
 



 programs. We are now taking this experience beyond our centres and into the communities
 



 where families live.
 



  





 Over the last three months, we have already gone live in 12\+ apartments, bringing Openhouse's
 



 learning experiences directly into residential communities. This is just the beginning. Our
 



 ambition is to build a significant At Apartment and At Home presence across Bangalore, making
 



 high\-quality learning accessible without children having to travel across the city.
 



  





**Why sports?** 




  





**Sports will be one of the strongest pillars of this expansion.** 




  





 Apartments already have something that makes sports uniquely powerful — children, facilities and
 



 communities in one place. Whether it is a badminton court, football ground, swimming pool,
 



 skating area or multipurpose space, there is an opportunity to turn existing community
 



 infrastructure into a vibrant sporting ecosystem for children.
 



  





 But great sports programs need more than just a facility. They need great coaches, strong
 



 academies, consistent operations and, importantly, opportunities for children to compete and
 



 progress.
 



  





  





**That's where openhouse comes in.** 




  





 We want to build a sports network where a child can discover a sport, find a great coach, train
 



 consistently, participate in competitions and progress — all within or close to their own
 



 community.
 



  





**about the role Preschool \& Extracurriculars** 




 We are looking for a Sports Category Manager who can build this ecosystem from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional vendor\-management or operations role. You will be responsible for
 



 building the supply side of Openhouse Sports — creating relationships with individual coaches
 



 and academies, identifying and onboarding great talent, and building a network that allows us to
 



 launch sports programs rapidly across apartments.
 



  





  





 There will be three key ways in which we build our sports network:
 



  





**1\. Build the supply ourselves** 




 Where an apartment has a sports facility but no coach, identify the requirement, find the right
 



 coach and deploy them.
 



  





  





**2\. Partner with individual coaches** 




 Identify talented coaches who are currently teaching independently but may be looking for a
 



 better professional opportunity. Give them access to multiple apartments and take away the
 



 operational workload, allowing them to focus on what they do best — coaching children.
 



  





  





**3\. Partner with established academies** 




 Work with existing cricket, football, badminton, swimming, skating, karate and other sports
 



 academies to bring their best coaches into Openhouse communities. In return, help these
 



 academies expand their footprint across Bangalore without disrupting their existing coach\-
 



 student ecosystem.
 



  





  





 Alongside this, you will help build an Openhouse sports competition ecosystem — inter\-
 



 apartment tournaments, leagues and events that give children opportunities to compete, create
 



 stronger community engagement and make sports a long\-term habit.
 



  





**what you will own Preschool \& Extracurriculars** 



* Build a strong network of individual coaches across major sports.
* Identify and establish partnerships with leading sports academies across Bangalore.
* Build a ready\-to\-deploy pool of coaches for new apartment launches.
* Own coach identification, evaluation and onboarding.
* Work with existing apartment coaches and explore opportunities to bring them into the



 Openhouse ecosystem.
 


* Map apartment facilities and requirements to the right coaches/academies.
* Build and manage long\-term relationships with coaches and academy partners.
* Work with the broader Openhouse team to launch sports programs across apartments.
* Track coach quality, parent feedback, attendance and retention.
* Build a calendar of tournaments, leagues and inter\-apartment competitions.
* Develop relationships with sports communities, clubs, tournament organisers and other



 relevant ecosystem players.
 


* Work with the marketing team to leverage competitions and sporting events for community



 engagement and brand visibility.
 



  





**who we’re looking for** 



* 3–5\+ years of experience in sports management, sports operations, academy management,



 coaching networks or a similar role.
 


* Strong understanding of the Bangalore sports ecosystem.
* Existing relationships with coaches, academies, clubs, sporting organisations or tournament



 organisers will be a significant advantage.
 


* Ideally, someone with a strong sports background who understands coaching, coaches and



 the sporting ecosystem.
 


* Exposure to multiple sports — cricket, football, badminton, swimming, skating, karate, tennis,



 squash etc.
 


* Strong relationship\-building and negotiation skills.
* Someone who is comfortable getting out of the office, meeting coaches and academy owners



 and building relationships on the ground.
 


* Strong execution orientation and an entrepreneurial mindset.
* Experience organising tournaments, leagues, competitions or sports events is highly desirable.



  





**Bangalore\-based** 
 with a strong local network.
 



  





**Success Metrics** 



* Your success will not simply be measured by the number of coaches onboarded.
* We want you to build the foundation of a
 **scalable Openhouse Sports ecosystem:**



**Great coaches → Great programs → More apartments → More children playing → More** 




**competitions → Stronger retention.** 



* Over the first 6–12 months, you should help us build a strong coach and academy network



 across Bangalore, enable rapid sports launches across apartments and establish competitions
 



 as a core part of the Openhouse sports experience.
 


* Ultimately, the ambition is simple: Make openhouse the most trusted sports partner for



 children and families living in communities across Bangalore.
 



  





**the practical bits** 



* Location: Bangalore
* Experience: 3\-5\+ years
* Function: Category Lead, Sports
* Reporting to: Head of Business \& Revenue

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

 More details about our company culture and perks can be found on our career page.

 **imposter syndrome** 
 may sometimes hinder exceptional candidates from applying. So, don't hold back—apply with confidence!

 Adjust is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We champion a diverse and inclusive culture in all of our offices around the globe. If you see a position that excites you, please apply! We would love to have you join us in our mission to build a global tech company where we're all proud to belong to.
   

  

 To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology\-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.
